description: telegram: Channel Details. GET /v1/telegram/channel. Provide one of: handle, url. Get public Telegram channel or group details from its web preview. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
